summary: Tompkins Financial Corp filed an 8-K on July 24, 2026, reporting its Q2 2026 earnings and a dividend declaration. The press release disclosed diluted EPS of $2.04, net income of $29.3 million, and a $0.70 per share dividend payable August 14, 2026, to holders of record August 7, 2026. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement under Items 2.02 and 8.01. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation activity is present. The filing is a standard current report with no transactional terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics beyond the dividend. What to watch: typical quarterly performance metrics and dividend sustainability; no risk-arb angle.
